how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Delhi University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Delhi University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position announced by Delhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Social Work with 55% marks, along with NET/SET qualification or Ph.D. exemption.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely via email. Candidates need to send their resume and documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an offline interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions as Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty).

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is R&P/313/2025.

faq.question: Q10. Does Delhi University offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Specific details regarding age relaxation are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for comprehensive information.
